description.narrative: IFC anticipates that the Project would result in improved access to eyewear products for individuals in Latin America, potentially improving health outcomes related to vision care. Beyond the Project, this investment has the potential to improve the competitiveness of the eyewear market across Latin America by sustaining affordability.

Lentesplus (or the Company) was founded in 2013 in Colombia. The Company is an omnichannel platform that commercializes eyewear products (ophthalmic glasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses). It operates in Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Mexico, under the brand Lentesplus, and, in Brazil, under two brands (i) NewLentes, contact lenses e-commerce and (ii) Livo, eyewear retailer.
